ruleDefinitions.name: Change PowerShell Policies to an Insecure Level - PowerShell
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects changing the PowerShell script execution policy to a potentially insecure level using the "Set-ExecutionPolicy" cmdlet. Note: Unmapped fields: ScriptBlockText

sequences.query: (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Set\\-ExecutionPolicy.*") AND (ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*Unrestricted.*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*bypass.*"))) AND  NOT ((ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\(New\\-Object\\ System\\\.Net\\\.WebClient\\)\\\.DownloadString\\(\\'https\\:\\/\\/community\\\.chocolatey\\\.org\\/install\\\.ps1\\'\\).*") OR ScriptBlockText = RGX(".*\\(New\\-Object\\ System\\\.Net\\\.WebClient\\)\\\.DownloadString\\(\\'https\\:\\/\\/chocolatey\\\.org\\/install\\\.ps1\\'\\).*")))
